touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Edenham qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST MICHAEL AND ALL ANGELS and Churchyard cross, St Michael's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Edenham: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
